b: The uncommitted are prisoners of possibility. Keeping your options open restricts decisions.
The Right Commitment Sets You Free
Indecision. You move from “should I” to “How will I?”
Distraction. You’re empowered to say no.
Adapt. A clear goal frees you to explore the best path.
Evaluate. A destination sets a standard to measure progress.
Feel discomfort. A worthy goal justifies resolve.
Noble responsibility frees you to do what matters.
A commitment is a decision you make once and act on repeatedly.
Which best align with your values and aspirations?
What are you willing to let go?
Who will you become on the journey?
You can’t say yes to everything and give your best to anything.
How much time and energy will you invest?
What are you taking out of your bucket?
How will you know you’re succeeding?
Forget about perfect conditions. Move out.
Be firm about purpose and flexible about execution.
Forget about “might.” Choose “I will.” Move from “If things work out” to “I’ll make it work.”
Where is keeping your options open keeping you stuck?
